result.title: Training Specialist LLMs on Your Phone: Forward-Only Optimization via Block-Spectral Coordinates
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) on personal devices keep user data local, but limited memory restricts their general capability. Since most user-specific tasks do not require the breadth of frontier models, a practical solution is to adapt a shared on-device model into lightweight specialists. However, backpropagation is prohibitive in memory, and users rarely provide labeled data. We present MobileSpec, a system that trains specialists with forward passes alone and learns from automatically checked task outcomes, as in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Because forward-only updates are built from random perturbations, training is efficient only when these perturbations resemble the weight changes of RLVR, which largely preserve the singular values of pretrained weights and rotate their singular vectors. The core algorithm of MobileSpec, FuRA-S, produces such perturbations while training only the block-spectral coordinates of pretrained weights, namely the singular values of their column blocks. As we show theoretically and empirically, rescaling these blocks independently shifts their relative contributions to each weight matrix and thereby rotates its singular vectors. Since this update can be rewritten as a transformation of the layer input, FuRA-S also adapts INT4 models without modifying their weights. With specialists of only 1-5 MB that update 0.015-0.05% of the parameters, MobileSpec raises the success rate of a phone-use agent from 6-23% up to 89-100% and trains a personalized 8B model on an iPhone 16 Pro overnight. On RLVR benchmarks, FuRA-S is competitive with full-parameter evolution strategies (ES) and outperforms ES over LoRA adapters and quantized ES on INT4 models.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MobileSpec，用仅前向传播的随机扰动训练端侧 LLM 专家；核心 FuRA-S 只更新预训练权重列块的奇异值，以模拟 RLVR 的谱结构变化并适配 INT4 模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其仅前向、低内存的谱约束更新可为 latent 推理轨迹的贡献分配与训练监督提供低成本借鉴线索，但与视觉证据筛选和推理期状态生成无直接联系，迁移可行性有待核查。
